checked_scientific_boundaries: Selected method is original ConPath, all three recorded parent seeds 20260910/20260911/20260912; no outcome-picked seed or ensemble. Display seed 20260910 is fixed by listed seed order.

Parent-isolated 100/25/40 cohort and K32/K4 results are separate from historical overlapping 160/160 cohort K128 and from two-seed coherent follow-up. Missing current direct-query/no-event/no-global measurements stay missing.
Historical direct-query is one seed 20260831; coordinate-query three-seed model is not relabeled. Same-checkpoint mean maps remain additional controls and one binary output.
RQ1 shuffle preserves empirical hard-world cell counts, not an exact infinite factorized posterior. Its historical overlap caveat prevents a confirmatory unseen-place claim.
RQ2 historical no-event/no-global evidence remains historical; no-event still has event-based selection, and no-global retains encoder context and local noise.
Independent per-cell final Gumbel sampling belongs to original ConPath; spatially correlated categorical noise is a distinct two-seed candidate, not the selected method.
Radius disk inclusion proves monotonicity only for the same worlds and disk/four-neighbor geometry; units remain cells. It does not prove empirical calibration or continuous collision safety.

Sample-pair U-score is unbiased for conditional-world expected event squared error under independent world draws and K>1; ordinary finite-K Brier includes sampling variance. Negative individual U estimates do not contradict nonnegative expected squared loss.
Exact hard forward correction versus bounded straight-through gradient is identified for the new parent cohort; the older bounded training/selection operator is not silently replaced in history.

Fixed-threshold false-safe is conditioned on accepted queries and reported with coverage; equal-30%-coverage risk uses label-independent fractional ties and is not called confidence-0.8 risk. Undefined zero-coverage risk is not zero.

Seed SD, conditional paired bootstrap intervals, and source/parent resampling are distinct. Historical overlap is not repaired by subscene bootstrap. No superiority to deterministic or uniform safety gain is asserted.
No-event lower fixed-threshold risk and much lower coverage, one-seed direct-query lower ECE, parent deterministic higher IoU, and coherent uncertain paired gain are retained as counterevidence.
